name: BioXcel Therapeutics, Inc.

pe.note: negative earnings; also no longer a normal going concern (Chapter 11 debtor)

catalysts.headline: Per the bidding-procedures motion, competing bids for BioXcel's assets were due Oct 9, 2026, with an auction proposed for Oct 14, 2026, ahead of an Oct 30, 2026 outside date for the sale; auction outcome (whether Teva's stalking-horse bid prevailed) could not be confirmed
Common stock trading suspended on Nasdaq at market open; migrated to OTC Pink Limited Market under new ticker BTAIQ; company said it does not intend to appeal

BioXcel Therapeutics and two subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Delaware (Case No. 26-11360); Teva Pharmaceuticals named stalking-horse bidder for IGALMI/dexmedetomidine assets ($57.5M upfront + up to $67.5M milestones); Oaktree Capital and Qatar Investment Authority providing $19M new-money DIP financing (total DIP facility $77M)
BioXcel Therapeutics and two subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions; entered an asset sale agreement with Teva Pharmaceuticals as stalking-horse bidder in a court-supervised sale process
catalysts.impact: stock collapsed from ~$0.72 to ~$0.18 over the following sessions

catalysts.headline: FDA accepted BioXcel's sNDA to expand IGALMI label to at-home/outpatient use (Phase 3 SERENITY At-Home trial); PDUFA target action date Nov 14, 2026
